checks.name: exact-representation-pair
checks.detail: Only absolute and prediction-origin-relative inputs are compared.

checks.name: same-stack-fold-and-boundaries
checks.detail: Both representations use the same stack, fold, and chronological boundaries.

checks.name: origins-and-input-timestamps-identical
checks.detail: Absolute and relative variants receive identical N=15 origin schedules and timestamps.

checks.name: targets-and-target-timestamps-identical
checks.detail: Every paired forecast is scored against the same future Utot targets.

checks.name: anchors-and-residual-labels-identical
checks.detail: Anchor/reconstruction and residual target are unchanged.

checks.name: absolute-input-is-unchanged-raw-history
checks.detail: Absolute variant uses only legal observed Utot history.

checks.name: relative-input-is-exact-origin-subtraction
checks.detail: Relative variant subtracts observed Utot(t) from each history element, with no target-time access.

checks.name: analytical-baseline-history-identical
checks.detail: Persistence and Linear Trend see the same absolute voltage history in both representations.
